scope: The single upstream document behind SERVING.md's protocol-ceiling paragraph: the Model Context Protocol specification's own Key Changes page for revision 2026-07-28. Resolved to corroborate WHY that revision is not offered by either host and what offering it would cost. No dependency admission and no source-lock promotion is implied: this receipt pins the bytes a documentation claim cites, nothing more.

resolver.tooling: curl (fetch), git hash-object (blob identity), shasum -a 256 (content digest)

artifacts.corroboration: The blob identity GitHub's tree listing names for this path was re-derived locally from the fetched bytes with git hash-object and matched, so the bytes read are the bytes the pinned commit holds.

claimsCorroborated.claim: Protocol-level sessions and the Mcp-Session-Id header are removed from the Streamable HTTP transport.
The initialize / notifications/initialized handshake is removed; every request carries its protocol version and client capabilities in _meta.
server/discover is added and servers MUST implement it.
SSE stream resumability and message redelivery (Last-Event-ID, SSE event ids) are removed; a broken stream means the client MUST re-issue the request.
Roots, Sampling, and Logging are deprecated.
Standard MCP request headers Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name are required on Streamable HTTP POST requests.
claimsCorroborated.correction: SERVING.md carried this item without an attribution, adjacent to the SEP-2577 clause; the changelog attributes it to SEP-2243, and the document now says so.

supports: SERVING.md's 'protocol ceiling' section: the statement of what revision 2026-07-28 changes, and therefore the statement that offering it means a new adapter at a new effect pin.
doesNotSupport: Any claim about the pinned effect adapter's conformance to any revision, about this estate's hosts implementing 2026-07-28, or about the content of the linked SEP pull requests themselves (only the changelog's own attributions are pinned here).
